competitors.name: @capacitor-firebase/authentication
competitors.whatItIs: Capawesome's Capacitor plugin that signs users in natively through Firebase Authentication on Android, iOS and web.

prices.note: Apache-2.0 license, version 8.6.0 on the npm registry

competitors.strongerThere: Choose @capacitor-firebase/authentication if your app already lives on Firebase Authentication and you want many providers, phone and email sign-in from one plugin today.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose Capacitor Auth Manager if you want Google sign-in that hands you the token without a Firebase dependency in the web bundle, so the same call works with Firebase or your own backend.

competitors.name: @codetrix-studio/capacitor-google-auth
competitors.whatItIs: The long-standing Google-only Capacitor plugin many apps started with, now marked as virtually archived by its own README.

prices.note: MIT license, latest 3.4.0-rc.4 published 2024-05-01 on the npm registry

competitors.strongerThere: Choose @codetrix-studio/capacitor-google-auth if you are on Capacitor 6 or older with a working integration and are not ready to move.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose Capacitor Auth Manager if you want a maintained Google sign-in for Capacitor 7 and 8 that keeps the same account chooser on Android and moves the token to result.credential.idToken.

competitors.name: @capgo/capacitor-social-login
competitors.whatItIs: Capgo's one-plugin bundle of social logins for Capacitor, the alternative the codetrix README itself points to.

prices.note: MPL-2.0 license, version 8.7.7 on the npm registry

competitors.strongerThere: Choose @capgo/capacitor-social-login if you need Apple, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Telegram or generic OAuth2 sign-in in a Capacitor app today.
competitors.strongerHere: Choose Capacitor Auth Manager if Google is the provider you ship now and you want a legacy GoogleSignIn account chooser on Android with Credential Manager as the fallback, plus typed React, Vue and Angular bindings under an MIT license.

competitors.name: @capacitor-community/facebook-login
competitors.whatItIs: The Capacitor Community plugin for Facebook Login and App Events on Android, iOS and web.

competitors.strongerHere: Choose Capacitor Auth Manager if the provider you need is Google and you want the same signIn call and result shape on web, iOS and Android.

competitors.name: @capacitor-community/apple-sign-in
